_method_note: STATE-MH-WIDENING v2 REPRODUCIBILITY HEADER. one-row-per-state-year. Every USD in rows with source_refs of this pass was read in-session from the cited keyless document (pdftotext -layout, visual render parse via PyMuPDF for scrambled tables, or printed figures in HFA/LBB briefs). v1 rows carried verbatim (values, value_kind, notes, sources unchanged). null = routes-tried-no-capture, never a placeholder. value_kind per vintage: actual/available/budgeted/recommended/estimated/exec-basis/TAFP — actual and budgeted vintages are NEVER blended in the per-capita test (the test script drops non-matching kinds to the budgeted-or-actual-baseline flag). State-appropriation rows for MI = combined behavioral-health gross appropriations (Traditional-Medicaid BH + HMP BH + Non-Medicaid/State-Psych), a broader grain than other states: flagged mh_grain=combined-BH. OK rows are requested/budgeted BPR appropriations (dept 452). LA rows are OBH agency 09-330 total expenditures / total means of finance in the executive-budget supporting documents. TX rows are BIENNIUM cross-article all-funds totals (value_kind=biennial) — not annual, NOT used in the within-state test. Built 2026-11-22 by build_state_mh_series_v2.py; sources cached in _stmh2/ and _stmh/. State-pop conversions: static-approx state pops FLAGGED per row at test time; city pops banked-first law kept.

STATE-MH-LANE REPRODUCIBILITY HEADER. one-row-per-state-year. Every USD = read directly in-session from the cited keyless document (pdftotext/HTML extraction). null = routes-tried-no-capture (TX/LA), never a placeholder. value_kind explains the budget basis (adopted-act vs GAA vs recommended vs county-spending grain). county_allocation_table_available: OH=True (LSC series gives per-county state-MH USD for all 88 counties), PA/MI=partial (county grain inside county-submitted plans / CMHSP contract letters), TN=False keyless (tn.gov bot-block), MA/NY/MO/OK=False (no state-published by-county USD table). Per-capita: OH FY2025 Hamilton = 18,505,260 / 827,359 pop ≈ $22.4 state-MH per capita (both figures verbatim from same LSC pdf). Built 2026-11-22 by build_state_mh_series_v1.py; workdir _stmh/ holds all source PDFs+txt for re-run.
